storyCards.headline: Havana: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Camila Cabello's "Havana" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Havana" is a song by American singer Camila Cabello featuring American rapper Young Thug, from her debut studio album Camila (2018).

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 45 weeks on the chart.

Havana was released in 2018.
